description: This file defines a React component named 'Scanner' used for ticket check-in via QR code or ticket ID. It manages state for input payload, device ID, scan results, and error messages. The component renders a form with input fields and displays scan status or errors. It interacts with an API client to perform the scan operation.

methods.name: Scanner
methods.description: React functional component handling the ticket scanning process.

methods.name: onScan
methods.description: Async event handler function that performs the ticket scan when form is submitted.
